breadcrumb.why: bestax `Breadcrumb` renders the `<ul>` itself and adds an `aria-label`

fixed-grid.why: `Grid isFixed` renders the `.fixed-grid` wrapper itself, from `fixedCols`; replace the wrapper and its `.grid` with one `Grid`, by hand

checkbox.why: bestax `Checkbox` renders its own styled markup, not Bulma's

checkboxes.why: bestax `Checkboxes` renders its own `.field` and `.control` wrappers

radio.why: bestax `Radio` renders its own styled markup, not Bulma's

radios.why: bestax `Radios` renders its own `.field` and `.control` wrappers

select.why: bestax `Select` renders the `.select` wrapper and the `<select>` together

file.why: bestax `File` renders the whole `.file-label` tree itself

dropdown.why: bestax `Dropdown` renders its own trigger and menu from props

icon.why: bestax `Icon` renders its own `<i>` and adds an `aria-label`

icon-text.why: bestax `IconText` pairs with `Icon`, which renders its own `<i>`

menu.why: bestax `Menu.Item` renders the `<li>` and the `<a>` together

message.why: bestax `Message` always wraps its children in `.message-body`

modal.why: bestax `Modal` renders its own background and content parts, and adds dialog attributes

navbar-burger.why: bestax `Navbar.Burger` is a `<button>` that renders its own spans and `aria-expanded`, so rebuild the toggle with it, by hand

navbar-link.why: inside a `Navbar.Dropdown`, bestax `Navbar.Link` adds `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded` and keyboard handling, so convert the `.has-dropdown` item and its link together, by hand

pagination.why: bestax `Pagination` renders its own list items and adds navigation roles

panel.why: bestax `Panel` parts render their own tags and attributes (`Panel.Block` is an `<a>`, `Panel.Icon` adds an `aria-label`)

tabs.why: bestax `Tabs` renders each tab's `<li>` and `<a>` together, with tab roles

help.why: bestax renders `.help` only inside its form controls

label.why: bestax renders `.label` only inside its form controls

loader.why: bestax `Loading` is an overlay, not Bulma's inline spinner

hero-buttons.why: a layout class inside `.hero`; bestax has no part for it

hero-video.why: a layout class inside `.hero`; bestax has no part for it

navbar-content.why: a layout class inside `.navbar`; bestax has no part for it

navbar-tabs.why: a layout class inside `.navbar`; bestax has no part for it

theme-dark.why: a theme scope; bestax sets themes through `Theme`

theme-light.why: a theme scope; bestax sets themes through `Theme`

fa.why: Font Awesome's own class, styled by Bulma inside `.icon`

marginless.why: a Bulma helper with no bestax prop

paddingless.why: a Bulma helper with no bestax prop

legacy.tile: Bulma v1 removed tiles; rebuild the layout with `Grid` and `Cell` (see the Bulma 0.9 to 1 guide)

passthrough.why: a color shade, a scheme color or a palette; shades stay as classes
a breakpoint bestax's per-viewport props do not cover
a Grid or Cell class, which converts only on its own `.grid` or `.cell`, and only where bestax has a prop for it
a `.fixed-grid` column count, which stays with its `.fixed-grid` (a family this source leaves as markup)
a Bulma helper with no bestax prop
a modifier of markup this source leaves alone, or one bestax has no prop for
